name: MCP A2A AP2 Food Delivery & Payments
description: Enables AI agents to discover and order food from multiple delivery services (DoorDash, UberEats, Grubhub) using A2A protocol and process payments via Stripe with AP2 protocol mandates for cryptographically signed user authorization.
